purpose: Test removal of the two-virtual-electron restriction through physical residual charge/spin sector completion
support_selection: One literal Hamiltonian residual in the complete two-site physical N,S basis; SVD after removal of the exact old left support; whole spin multiplets and degenerate singular blocks
state_retention: Copy the existing canonical left support and right coefficients, with exact zeros on added channels; verify energy and density before the local variational update
acceptance: Unchanged state and physical guards, strict variational energy reduction, and nonzero probability for at least three electrons in initially virtual orbitals
reference_use: No correlated reference energies or densities loaded, generated, fitted, selected or used for stopping
scope: One missing-sector physical response experiment; not global tensor stationarity, global minimization, chemical accuracy, WTMAD-2 or a breakthrough
resource_limit: One CUDA job, one host core, at most 1 GB new project disk; unchanged 40 GB total budget
